info.sub_ename: THE INDUSTRY APPLICATIONS OF CHEMICAL MATERIALS

description.sub_ename: THE INDUSTRY APPLICATIONS OF CHEMICAL MATERIALS
description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹化工材料於半導體、光電、民生、生化生醫產業的應用與發展，並介紹化工材料性質分析、材料設計基礎原理、生產流程，內容涵蓋先進製程，連結理論與實務，學生必須具備物理、化學及工程基礎。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the development and application of chemical materials in semiconductor, optoelectronics, chemical products, biochemical and biomedical industries. The characteristics of chemical materials, the basic principles of material, and the manufacturing process will also be introduced. The course covers advanced technologies to link fundamental theories and practical applications. Students must have basic knowledge in physics, chemistry and engineering.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解化工材料之性質、設計原理及其於半導體、光電、民生化材、生醫生化等產業之重要性。
targets.describe_en: To understand the properties of chemical materials, design principles and their importance in semiconductor, optoelectronics, biochemical, biomedical and other industries.

targets.describe_ch: 膫解化工材料於各產業鏈之製程技術。
targets.describe_en: To understand the process technologies of chemical materials in various industrial chains.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解化工材料製程整合與分析技術
targets.describe_en: To learn process integration and analytic technology of chemical materials.
